title: [Bugfix] Fix KV cache memory accounting for Ascend multi-allocation layouts
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?
This PR fixes a KV cache initialization failure when serving DeepSeek V4.1 on Ascend, caused by https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/53558.
When https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/18359 merged, this patch can be removed.

The newer builder-based KV cache planner in vLLM uses` KVCacheConfigBuilder._get_pool_bytes_per_block() `to determine the memory consumption per KV cache block. When this method returns None, vLLM falls back to probing a one-block placement and expects all device-backed KV cache tensors to have the same backing allocation size. However, Ascend's specialized KV cache layouts (including DSV4.1) can involve multiple backing allocations with different sizes.

For DSV4.1, this causes the engine to fail during KV cache initialization:

```
ValueError: KV cache tensors must share one device
backing allocation, but got sizes [131072, 147712].
Override KVCacheConfigBuilder._get_pool_bytes_per_block()
for placements with several device allocations.
```

Ascend already provides specialized per-block memory accounting through _`ascend_pool_bytes_per_block()`, but the newer builder-based planner does not use this existing override because it calls a different hook.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?
N/A

### How was this patch tested?
```
MODEL_PATH="/root/.cache/modelscope/hub/models/Eco-Tech/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-w8a8"

export VLLM_USE_V2_MODEL_RUNNER=0
export VLLM_ENGINE_READY_TIMEOUT_S=36000
export PYTORCH_NPU_ALLOC_CONF=expandable_segments:True

export HCCL_BUFFSIZE=1024
export HCCL_OP_EXPANSION_MODE="AIV"
vllm serve "$MODEL_PATH" \
--host 0.0.0.0 \
--port 8900 \
--max-model-len 150000 \
--max-num-batched-tokens 8192 \
--served-model-name dsv41 \
--gpu-memory-utilization 0.95 \
--max-num-seqs 32 \
--data-parallel-size 4 \
--tensor-parallel-size 4 \
--enable-expert-parallel \
--tokenizer-mode deepseek_v41 \
--reasoning-parser deepseek_v41 \
--tool-call-parser deepseek_v41 \
--enable-auto-tool-choice \
--safetensors-load-strategy lazy \
--quantization ascend \
--block-size 128 \
--compilation-config '{"cudagraph_mode":"FULL_DECODE_ONLY"}' \
--async-scheduling \
--engram-config '{"cpu_offload":true,"dp_shared_memory":true}' \
--additional-config '{
    "ascend_compilation_config":{
        "enable_npugraph_ex":true,
        "enable_static_kernel":false
    },
    "enable_cpu_binding":true,
    "enable_fused_mc2":1,
    "enable_dsa_cp":false,
    "enable_flashcomm1":false,
    "enable_shared_expert_dp":true
}'
```
